stem: Meena wets the clay roof of her house with water on a hot afternoon in Jaipur. After some time, the roof feels cooler. Why does this happen?

options.text: The water evaporates and takes heat away from the roof
The water stops the Sun's rays from reaching the roof
The clay roof releases cold air when it gets wet
The water becomes ice on the hot roof

teacher.key_rationale: Evaporation of the water takes heat from the roof's surface, producing a cooling effect; the other options describe processes that do not occur.
